feeds.title: Bures Music Festival
feeds.description: Bures Music Festival is the East Anglian summer event of the year for music lovers of all ages and tastes. This unique festival supports a multitude of musical genres from jazz to blues, rock to pop, plus a popular choral night. We're open to welcoming internationally known bands and musicians to our stage, as well as supporting emerging acts and local talent.

feeds.title: Southwell Music Festival
feeds.description: Southwell Music Festival is an annual, top-quality classical music festival that takes place each August Bank Holiday to celebrate classical music, raise the profile of the town and its magnificent medieval Minster, and inspire local musicians, especially young people.

feeds.title: NME » Festivals Blog
feeds.description: NME brings you the latest music and pop culture news and reviews, along with videos and galleries, band features, concert tickets, magazine, radio and more.

feeds.title: Rave Hackers
feeds.description: Rave Hackers is an EDM music festival blog dedicated to sharing insider tips and tricks to surviving any music festival and EDM event. We share preparation, travel, and camping advice, as well as outfit inspiration and small business, to support the industry.

feeds.title: The Groove Cartel » Festivals
feeds.description: The Groove Cartel thegroovecartel.com is a web portal, a music community, and a platform for artists. With an entire dedicated blog for the latest news around the music world and festivals, a music record label, and a diffused network of partners we offer one of the most complete solutions for your sake of knowledge of the underground music world.

feeds.title: Sherpa Land » Festival
feeds.description: Explore our Festival section for fabulous festival content we've curated and created. Sherpa Land is the best online guide to help you discover festivals, music, entertainment, travel, food, sneakers, tech, and gaming culture around the world.

feeds.title: Pickathon Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date on the latest news and special offers. The Pickathon is an annual three-day music festival featuring a wide variety of artists from genres including indie, rock, rap, folk, and bluegrass. The festival is well known for promoting more sustainable environmental practices; offering eco-friendly transportation, recycling and composting, and the elimination of plastic tableware. Pickathon also offers camping and food options on-site.

feeds.title: Music Festival Explorer
feeds.description: My name is Rob and you are currently on my website, Music festival Explorer. This website is my zone to upload the stories of my festival experiences, as well as impact some knowledge I have gained over the years. Music Festival explorer can be your place for tips, tricks, tales, and histories of everything music festival related.

feeds.title: Spirit of Woodstock Festival Blog
feeds.description: The Spirit of Woodstock Festival in Mirapuri with its continuous five days flow of international music and brand-new cyber rock, cyber dance, cyberbanking, orgastica-DJ, cyberpoetry, and new topical songs along with the Mirapuri open nature camping has developed into one of Europe's greatest free music event with free entrance and friendly prices for food, drinks, and hotel accommodation. Explore the blog to know more.

feeds.title: Roadburn Festival
feeds.description: Roadburn is a leading light in the world of heavy music. Unrestricted by genre, Roadburn has an underground ethos that is coupled with big-league production values that allow us to champion scene-defining bands and pioneers alongside up-and-coming artists. We pride ourselves on creating a truly immersive experience every April.

feeds.title: Eastern Music Festival
feeds.description: Eastern Music Festival is a nationally recognized classical music festival and summer educational program nurturing talented youth through a collaborative learning process. Its mission is to promote musical enrichment, excellence, professional collaboration, innovation, and diversity through music festivals, concerts, and other programs which will enhance the quality of life, health, and vitality of our region.

feeds.title: Coltrane Jazz Fest Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about the musicians performing in this festival on Coltrane Jazz Fest Blog. The John Coltrane International Jazz and Blues Festival is a two-day music festival honoring the life and legacy of jazz saxophone icon, John Coltrane. The only goal is to make the John Coltrane International Jazz and Blues Festival the premiere entertainment destination in the Southeast.

feeds.title: Festival Insights
feeds.description: Festival Insights is an online B2B publication focused on the international festival industry. It comprises the latest business news, thought leadership content, and comprehensive features. From historic behemoths to small-scale debutantes, the site's coverage encompasses the entire spectrum of the festival circuit.

feeds.title: Nebraska Crossroad Music Festival Blog
feeds.description: Go behind the scenes at Nebraska Crossroads Festival. Artist stories, curatorial insights, and local culture—fresh posts every week.

feeds.title: Colorado Music Festival
feeds.description: Get the latest news and stories about the Colorado Summer Classical Music Festival.

feeds.title: Music Reporter Blog » Music Festival
feeds.description: The Music Festival category on Music Reporter Blog highlights upcoming and past folk, bluegrass, Americana, and boutique music festival lineups—complete with dates, locations, ticket info, and festival vibes.

feeds.title: Zimfest News Blog
feeds.description: This blog is the main news channel for the Zimbabwean Music Festival (aka Zimfest). The Zimfest organizing committee posts updates on the annual festival, and the Zimfest Association board provides meeting minutes and other info.

feeds.title: Ojai Music Festival
feeds.description: The Ojai Music Festival blog offers in-depth, behind-the-scenes insights and stories about each year's program, artists, premieres, and the festival's central themes like community, renewal, and creative experimentation

feeds.title: The Festival Babes
feeds.description: n The Festival Babes blog is a colorful hub of first-hand festival stories, fashion guides, lifestyle tips, artist highlights, and empowering advice tailored for their female-focused EDM community.

feeds.description: The Festival category on Amplify Music Mag serves as a curated hub of news, previews, recaps, and insights on major music festivals.

feeds.title: RIFF Magazine Festivals
feeds.description: The Festivals category on RIFF Magazine offers curated coverage of music and arts festivals—from timely news and lineup announcements to in-depth previews, live reviews, photo essays, and cultural insights from events like Love Supreme, Outside Lands, and beyond

feeds.title: Consequence of Sound » Festival News and Rumors
feeds.description: Stay updated on the latest music festival news, rumors, lineups, ticket information, and more from Consequence of Sound. The consequence of Sound is an online music, film, and television publication. With a committed staff of writers, editors, graphic designers, and photographers, it is your go-to place for breaking music festival news and rumors.

feeds.title: Loudwire » Festivals
feeds.description: Ojai Music Festival is a platform celebrating innovative classical music and creative exploration. Its Festival Blog dives into artist stories, premieres, and behind-the-scenes insights from each annual event.

feeds.title: The SoulFest Blog
feeds.description: Find press releases, event updates, details, and more on The SoulFest Blog. SoulFest is New England's premier Christian music festival. At SoulFest, we truly believe that God's love is real, for everyone, prevails, and is unconditional. The purpose of SoulFest is to celebrate God's love and encourage all who attend to live from the inside out as soul-connected, risk-taking Believers in God's love.

feeds.title: The Guiting Music Festival
feeds.description: The Guiting Music Festival brings an exciting variety of highly talented performances of Classical, Jazz, and Blues music by artists from around the world. It is run entirely by a team of dedicated volunteers, which helps to keep the ticket prices down. The experience of going to the festival is enhanced by the local character of the village hall and the beauty of the views outside.

feeds.title: Wildflower Arts & Music Festival Blog
feeds.description: Come for the music, but experience so much more at Wildflower! Check out your favorite artist on a variety of stages on the festival grounds and inside the Eisemann Center, shop your way through the many artisans in the Marketplace, devour your favorite festival treat, catch a performance by a local acrobatic artist on Performance Row or grab a cold beer and bid on your favorite handmade guitar in the Art Guitar Auction.

feeds.title: Ravinia Backstage Blog
feeds.description: Read news, artists' reviews, history, and more on Ravinia's Backstage Blog. Ravinia is an internationally renowned, not-for-profit music festival that presents outstanding performances by the world's greatest artists. Ravinia's principal objectives are; to develop more diverse audiences for classical music through education and community engagement programs and by maintaining affordable ticket prices.

feeds.title: Worcester Music Festival Blog
feeds.description: The Worcester Music Festival is a free music festival run by volunteers to promote the local music scene one weekend a year. All money raised from fundraising during the Worcester Music Festival weekend goes to local charities. Worcester Music Festival news blog for more.

feeds.title: That Festival Blogger
feeds.description: Welcome to the Worldwide Festival Blog. I'm Sophie, the woman behind the 'That Festival Blogger', and a festival fanatic and experienced Marketer. I started this blog for camping tips, festival packing lists, festival outfit ideas, general festival advice, and festival reviews. This is a space where I challenge you to dream big and spend small.

feeds.title: Exodus Festival Las Vegas Blog
feeds.description: Explore the blog section for festival details, tales, and more. Las Vegas boasts some of the biggest pool parties and nightclubs in the world. Planning your epic weekend can get time-consuming, tricky, and expensive. Whether you are a local or a tourist, we have figured out the best way to have fun for you. Plan your epic weekend with Exodus Las Vegas.

feeds.title: Mountain Music Festival
feeds.description: The Mountain Music Festival was created as a summer weekend fest where outdoor adventures and music can be done at the same time. We provide the best outdoor activities, ranging from the country's best white water rafting, to rock climbing, to world-class mountain biking, and anything in between.

feeds.title: thatDROP.com » EDM Festivals
feeds.description: The EDM festival blog shares the best electronic music news and information on EDM festivals. thatDROP.com is an online publication dedicated to sharing electronic dance music, music festivals, EDM news, free EDM downloads, media, P.L.U.R., and EDM culture. The site is managed by passionate EDM enthusiasts focusing on quality, unique, original content, and community.

feeds.title: Music Festival Wizard
feeds.description: At Music Festival Wizard, they're your spirit guide to music festivals around the world. They cover everything from mega-festivals to the country to metal to jam and many more. Stay up to date with music festival news from around the world, articles, reviews, galleries, and more.
